title: Obstruction map: Standard Model particles and run composites

inputs.role: absent at build time; measured values taken from the table's copy

meta.reading: The defect class of a row is the centre class 6Y mod 6 of the particle, an element of Z6 = Z3 (colour centre) x Z2 (weak centre). MATCH.md reads the protected defect of class k as the particle of class k (lead L39). MAP.md and the simulation app (particle_map.json, internal_modes.splits) read a class as a flux of the centre that charged patterns see. Both readings carry the same label.
meta.unit: Run-data energies in GeV use E* = 1.22089e19 GeV. With one link crossed per tick the tick is hbar/E_cell with E_cell = E* P^(-1/2) = 0.78303 E* at P_fwd, so those values scale by 0.78303 (DC, MATCH.md).
meta.blindness: Measured values are compare-only and NOT BLIND. Worker OM computes no candidate value: every value is quoted from the report named beside it. The build script recomputes the pattern charges and the order of the circulant eigenvalues as checks.

SOURCE.meaning: No measured or declared input beyond the unit E*. Every SOURCE entry names its report and quotes the statement.

CONDITIONAL.meaning: Computed from the source together with the named declared, imported or target-informed items.

FIT.meaning: Chosen against measurement, or computed from inputs chosen against measurement.

OPEN.meaning: No value from the source; the running lane is named.

EXCLUDED.meaning: A computed value or construction that the comparison with measurement excludes (value-level status).
EXCLUDED.defined_in: SPECTRUM.md quark row; DF2.md; DG2.md; LNAT2.md

unit_E_star.name: unit E* = 1.22089e19 GeV
unit_E_star.statement: E* is the external unit of the public comparison branch (the Planck energy from the measured G). The status SOURCE admits it.

cubic_arrangement.name: cubic arrangement of carriers (CF-1 architecture)
cubic_arrangement.statement: Carriers sit on the cubic lattice of one of the five frames, a screen cell is the face dual to one crossing link, and one link is crossed per tick. The owner adopts or replaces this architecture (MASS_STEPS.md step A3).

E_cell.name: cell energy E_cell = E* P^(-1/2)
E_cell.statement: E_cell follows exactly from the cubic arrangement, a screen cell dual to one crossing link, one link per tick and E* = hbar c/l* (DC).

pixel_P.name: pixel P_fwd = 1.6309720958588973
pixel_P.statement: P_fwd is the forward root of the declared map P = phi + sqrt(pi) alpha(P) with the Thomson transport. The transport carries the Stage-5 continuation masses with the target-informed Koide balance inside (MAUD section 1.3, rows 2a and 2h). The forward root gives alpha^-1(0) = 136.994835, -300.4 ppm from CODATA (MAUD section 8).

slopes.name: one-loop slopes (33/5, 1, -3) between M_U and m_Z
slopes.statement: The slopes are the MSSM census. The source census is B, b = (61/10, -7/6, -5), with which the closure has no root; the slopes need one gluino and one wino off the code's line, and three source routes to odd adjoint states are closed (DB, DB2, DB3, GL).

closure_b_above.name: closure reading scale and the unified running b_above = +8.5131
closure_b_above.statement: The m_Z reading of the pixel closure is retired (DC2). The cut closure fixes 1/alpha(E_cell) = 16.2453 and reproduces the producer's chain at P_fwd if the unified coupling runs from E_cell to M_U with b_above = +8.5131; no source content supplies that number yet (DC2, DB2, LEW rebase).

R_of_P.name: M_U form, R(P) = ln(E_cell/M_U) = 2 pi - (2/3) ln P
R_of_P.statement: M_U = E* exp(-2 pi) P^(1/6) reduces to the single item R(P); the criticality midpoint is the same item (DC, LEW Addendum 3).

transmutation_law.name: transmutation law v = E_cell exp(-2 pi/(beta_EW alpha_U)), beta_EW = 4
transmutation_law.statement: The integer 4 has two exact source counts (four left doublets per generation; the fourth root of one instanton weight per cell four-volume); the law itself is declared (DC).

one_loop_running.name: one-loop running functional and the imported matching
one_loop_running.statement: The one-loop functional 1/alpha_i(mu) = 1/alpha_U + (b_i/2 pi) ln(M_U/mu) is imported, without thresholds, two-loop terms or scheme matching (DB).

law_selection.name: discrete repair-law choice of the W/Z chart
law_selection.statement: The zero-selector law and the carrier value law are two named points of a continuous family; the choice is not decidable on the executable source (LEW T2).

eta_slice.name: hypercharge slice alpha_Y -> alpha_Y (1 - 2 eta), eta = alpha_U cos 2 theta_W0
eta_slice.statement: The slice entered three days after a 0.46 GeV Z discrepancy was on record; no repository text gives its origin (MAUD section 1.3, row 4). No lane of FINAL_STEPS.md holds it.

vev_attachment.name: scale and scheme at which v_source is attached
vev_attachment.statement: The source attaches v twice, at Q0 = 91.588 GeV (D10 Z-scale law) and at m_t (D11 readout, Q_t = 162.008 GeV); under MSbar the two differ by 0.64 percent (LEW T3).

criticality_scale.name: criticality boundary scale mu_c = E* exp(-pi) P^(-1/6)
criticality_scale.statement: The source equations leave a one-parameter family of boundary scales with no flow condition (LEW T4). The log-midpoint was identified after the two-loop implied scale was computed (MAUD section 5, H2).

d11_readout.name: D11 readout: top-only two-loop running, v at m_t, tree m_H, QCD pole conversion
d11_readout.statement: The D11 engine reads m_t^MSbar = y_t(m_t) v/sqrt2 and m_H = sqrt(2 lambda(m_t)) v at mu = m_t (LEW link L10b, attachment A2).

smdr_readout.name: SMDR readout at Q0 with v_Landau_MSbar(Q0) = v_source
smdr_readout.statement: SMDR two-loop matching is standard physics; the attachment v_Landau_MSbar(Q0) = v_source is declared (LEW link L8b, MAUD section 4).

radian_per_read.name: one radian per read (premise B)
radian_per_read.statement: One nat per read (the declared crossing-read area-law dictionary) continued to one radian per read (the imported Wick correspondence) turns 2/9 expected exclusive reads per tick into a phase of 2/9 rad per tick (LNAT2 T2, ARGUED). A finite algebraic construction cannot give 2/9 rad (LNAT section 0, EXACT).

generation_register.name: generation register: two seam objects, a recorded source endpoint, a cross-object analyzer
generation_register.statement: The three characters 1, w, w^2 of the face third-turn label the copies (SPECTRUM.md item 1). The Koide operator C_2 needs the C repair components acting as g and g^-1, the E agreeing half as identity, a definite or recorded source endpoint of the C repair and a non-product analyzer across the two objects; the coherent law records no source endpoint and supplies no such analyzer (LNAT2 verdict).

a_clock.name: mass read on the A-clock (energy = expected reads per tick)
a_clock.statement: Premise (b) puts one hbar on each read, which selects the A-clock for the masses (LNAT2 T2, ARGUED). The Floquet rest phase of C_2(2/9) gives Q = 0.478 with ratios 14.38 and 58.97 (DA, LNAT2 T2).

lepton_dressing.name: lepton phase dressing delta = 2/9 - 1.75148e-7
lepton_dressing.statement: With Q = 2/3 held, the measured m_mu/m_e needs delta = 2/9 - 1.75148e-7 (-0.788 ppm); zeta is a pole shift and needs a three-family clock (DA2, DA3).

lepton_scale.name: lepton Yukawa scale y_J (Y_e = y_J C^2, tr C^2 = 1)
lepton_scale.statement: The missing premise reduces to one number, the prefactor of a trace-one operator; the four directions tried fail by factors 0.62 to 96 (LS). Needed (NOT BLIND): y_J = 0.0107994 at the pole, 0.0106064 running at m_Z. The repository declares the determinant weight 6^-14/2 (target-informed, MAUD section 2.1).

junction_ratio.name: lepton/quark junction weight ratio
junction_ratio.statement: Phases and native magnitudes give the lepton (3 + 3 -> 0) and quark (1 + 3 -> 4) junctions the same trace; the needed ratio y_J^e / tr Y_u is 0.0104 at Q0 and 0.0243 at mu_c (LS, NOT BLIND).

quark_branch_magnitude.name: branch-magnitude law of the quark junction
quark_branch_magnitude.statement: No phase can raise the circulant Q above the native 2/3 (E2); the quark sectors need x = p/q = 0.8316 (up, Htilde leg) and 0.6217 (down, H leg) at M_Z against the native 1/2 (DF2, NOT BLIND).

up_down_register.name: up/down register finer than Z6 that reaches the observables
up_down_register.statement: Z6 cannot split up from down (E1), and a Higgs on one face drops out of the masses (E3); the right-handed leg needs a sector-dependent transport after it absorbs the Higgs (DF2 NEXT 2).

quark_generation_phases.name: quark generation phases and V_CKM
quark_generation_phases.statement: Every Z6-only law gives V_CKM = 1 (DF2 E1). A link-phase defect of class 1 or 4 on the face splits w from w^2 with abs(b)/a = 1/55 (LNAT2 T1).

neutrino_suppression.name: suppression of the neutrino junction against the charged lepton
neutrino_suppression.statement: Both junctions are the two adjoint halves of one vertex, so y_nu/y_e = 1 in the source; the lowest separating operator has degree five (DG2). NU3 computes the fifth-order neutral transfer (audit: A(t) = -(151/3840) t^5).

neutrino_phase_mixing.name: neutrino circulant phase, mixing angles and splitting ratio
neutrino_phase_mixing.statement: The lepton phase 2/9 gives the splitting ratio 0.003535 against 0.030016, and no pair of icosahedral axes gives theta13 (DG2, NOT BLIND).

su3_links.name: continuous SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)/Z6 links, plaquette action, bare couplings
su3_links.statement: Colour links are Z3 registers in the runs; SU(3) link variables are open, and a pure Z3 gauge field has no running coupling (DE). The cut closure predicts the bare unified link coupling 1/alpha = 16.2453 at P_fwd (DC2).

link_phase_field.name: continuous link phase with its field step
link_phase_field.statement: With a continuous link phase the field step has a wave with two polarizations, stable at two field steps per tick with eps kappa = 1/4; no native link alphabet carries a Standard Model boson (X5).

one_cone_per_species.name: one Dirac cone per species (member B of the routing)
one_cone_per_species.statement: Member B (phi = 5 pi/16) leaves one Dirac cone per species, k_c = 1 and b0 = 7, at the price of the declared seam weights cos(3 pi/32) and sin(3 pi/32) and an arrow-toggling Wilson term; adoption is an owner decision (T3).

c_N.name: nucleon factor c_N = m_N/Lambda^(3)
c_N.statement: The repository's c_N = 2.775 equals 0.938/0.338, the measured proton mass over the world Lambda^(3), to 0.03 percent (DE, NOT BLIND).

higgs_register.name: Higgs-type register, its common-phase state, the angle and the four amplitudes
higgs_register.statement: A register with the charges of the two spinor levels restores the Gauss constraint; a definite angle needs the register in a state with a common phase; four amplitudes are allowed and none is fixed (MASS_STEPS.md step E3, R8).

spin_statistics.name: spin pointer and statistics of the patterns
spin_statistics.statement: Spin 1/2 is the faithful doublet of the cover of the frame group at rest with a declared pointer (MASS_STEPS.md B3); statistics is declared and antisymmetry is forced only by a filled reference (MASS_STEPS.md C1); CF-1 declares all 32 patterns fermionic (DB2).

class0_flux_object.name: oriented class-0 flux object (|m| = 6)
class0_flux_object.statement: Under the integer-flux grading G2, class 0 (E, nu^c) has no minimal flux object and needs |m| = 6 (DB3).

higgs_per_copy.name: one Higgs doublet per copy
higgs_per_copy.statement: Grading G2 gives one copy = Weyl Q, U, D, L plus one complex Higgs doublet, so three doublets for three copies; the direct check is the {3,3} carrier content (DB3 NEXT 2).

measured_mt.name: measured top mass 172.1 GeV as input
measured_mt.statement: One measured input, m_t = 172.1 GeV, enters the Higgs mass on the criticality curve (MAUD section 5).

class_identity.label: EXACT
class_identity.quote: On all 32 patterns of the five-level code k = 3 (n2 mod 2) - 2 (n3 mod 3), and the element (omega, -1, exp(2 pi i Y)) acts as the identity on every pattern (EXACT).
class_identity.statement: The defect class of every row is the centre class 6Y mod 6 of its pattern.

carrier_neutral.label: EXACT
carrier_neutral.quote: The classes on one carrier add to zero modulo 6, because the carrier is a closed screen.
carrier_neutral.statement: Every carrier content is colour-neutral and weak-neutral, with integer electric charge.

reactions_are_vertices.label: EXACT
reactions_are_vertices.quote: Reactions are the Standard Model vertices (every one of the 16 reaction types conserves the class)
reactions_are_vertices.statement: The run's reactions 1 + 5 -> 0, 1 + 3 -> 4, 1 + 2 -> 3, 3 + 3 -> 0 and 1 + 1 -> 2 carry the class content of the annihilation, quark mass, quark Yukawa, lepton mass and diquark vertices.

pair_kinds_are_placements.label: EXACT
pair_kinds_are_placements.quote: Quark flavours have no such equal pairs, so a kind is one placement of a meson on a carrier.
pair_kinds_are_placements.statement: The 6 lasting kinds of (2,4) pair and the 5 of (3,3) pair are rotation orbits of non-adjacent face pairs; mirror kinds occur equally often.

b_minus_l.label: EXACT
b_minus_l.quote: One does: B − L = 1 − (2/3) n3 per quantum, which equals N − (2/3)(N_v1 + N_v2 + N_v3).
b_minus_l.statement: The B - L column is 1 - (2/3) n3 of the pattern; every operation of the source conserves it.

also.quote: Every operation conserves B − L. It commutes with the twelve responses, the five level numbers and the toggle.

koide_weights.label: EXACT
koide_weights.quote: On an active seam, the agreeing branch (record 0) and the repair branch (record 1) each have weight 1/2. This holds for both load positions and both address orientations. The repair amplitude carries the sign of orientation times source endpoint. On the native code a seam is active with probability 1/3, so the weights are agree 1/6 and repair 1/12 + 1/12, on both the C and E seams.
koide_weights.statement: The branch weights of the coherent seam event, 1/6 : 1/12 : 1/12, give abs(b)/a = 1/sqrt2, so Q = 2/3 for the weights alone.
koide_weights.limits: LNAT2 qualifies the operator form: from its own records the coherent law gives a quadrature operator with Q in [0.343, 0.346]; the Koide circulant C_2 needs a definite or recorded source endpoint and a cross-object analyzer (item generation_register, lane FR).

also.quote: The record bit gives |b|/a = 1/√2 with no coin.
on an active seam the agreeing branch (record 0) and the repair branch (record 1, two orientations at 1/12 each) have equal weight 1/6 : 1/6, so p0 = pc = 1/2.
Q = 2/3 SOURCE: the coherent seam event's agreeing and repair branches weigh 1/2 each on an active seam (agree 1/6, repair 1/12 + 1/12), so abs(b)/a = 1/sqrt2 with no coin

koide_operator_condition.label: EXACT
koide_operator_condition.quote: With the source endpoint undetermined (the native code, or any source-symmetric readout), the family operator is a quadrature operator: Q in [0.343, 0.346] and every mass ratio below phi^2 = 2.618, for every clock phase.
koide_operator_condition.statement: The Koide circulant on the copies needs the two missing pieces of item generation_register.

also.quote: With the source endpoint fixed, and the orientation-odd readout joined to the E hold by a Fourier analyzer, it is C_2 with |b|/a = 1/sqrt2 exactly.

no_algebraic_two_ninths.label: EXACT
no_algebraic_two_ninths.quote: Theorem (EXACT). If z is a nonzero algebraic number, then arg z is not 2/9 rad (modulo 2 pi).
no_algebraic_two_ninths.statement: A phase of 2/9 rad needs a transcendental element, in practice a continuous clock; every finite algebraic part of the law gives other phases.

w_w2_split.label: EXACT
w_w2_split.quote: w and w^2 split for the link classes 1, 2, 4, 5. They do not split for k = 0, for class 3, or for any register defect, which the walk does not read.
w_w2_split.statement: A link-phase defect of a quark class splits the two complex characters through its Aharonov-Bohm phase pi k/9 with abs(b)/a = 1/55; the lepton class keeps them paired.

also.quote: a, |b| and arg b are (11/12, 1/60, pi k/9).

no_three_populations.label: MEASURED
no_three_populations.quote: Result: among the protected defects (faces of nonzero class at the end of the runs, and identities alive at the end), no property splits any class into three groups.
no_three_populations.statement: The classical census shows no three generations in any class (1,048 preregistered tests); a character is a phase and appears in the coherent dynamics only.

dirac_selected.label: EXACT
dirac_selected.quote: B - L = N - (2/3) n_v is conserved by every operation of the source, so the 16-state content gives Dirac neutrinos and forbids the Majorana pairing (EXACT, reports/DG.md)
dirac_selected.statement: On the 16-state content of one generation the neutrino is a Dirac fermion; the audit's 15-state module gives a massless neutrino instead (DG table).

also.quote: The Dirac sector keeps exactly this charge. The four Dirac channels with one Higgs doublet leave exactly X conserved. Adding the singlet pairing leaves nothing conserved.

one_vertex_nu_e.label: EXACT
one_vertex_nu_e.quote: They are the two adjoint halves of one vertex.
one_vertex_nu_e.statement: The neutrino and electron junctions carry one amplitude in the source.

quark_z6_blind.label: EXACT
quark_z6_blind.quote: Any Z6-only law, and any Z6 Aharonov-Bohm phase, therefore gives Y_u ∝ Y_d and V_CKM = 1.
quark_z6_blind.statement: Statements E1, E2 and E3 of DF2: the quark lane needs a branch-magnitude law and an up/down register beyond Z6.

also.quote: The native weights (agreeing half 1/6, each oriented repair 1/12, LNAT Q1) give Q ≤ 2/3.
So a Higgs sitting on one face drops out of the masses and the left frames.

class3_fermion_and_boson.label: EXACT
class3_fermion_and_boson.quote: Under every flux grading that depends only on the class, class 3 holds one fermion doublet and one boson doublet of opposite hypercharge per copy.
class3_fermion_and_boson.statement: Class 3 holds the lepton doublet and a Higgs-type doublet per copy, within grading models.

also.quote: With the chiral source's odd grading, the fermion is L = (1,2)₋₁/₂ and the boson is (1,2)₊₁/₂, the Standard Model Higgs quantum numbers.

grading_g2.label: EXACT
grading_g2.quote: So conjugate flux objects must carry opposite grading, and a (+3, −3) pair has opposite gradings automatically.
grading_g2.statement: Within the integer-flux grading model G2 one copy holds one Standard Model family and one Higgs doublet, and class 0 needs a flux object of |m| = 6.

also.quote: One copy under G2 = Weyl Q, U, D, L plus one complex Higgs doublet.
Class 0 (E, ν^c) has no minimal flux object and is inconsistent without one; it would need |m| = 6.

no_gauginos.label: EXACT
no_gauginos.quote: Adjoint sectors are always even, so odd adjoint link states are excluded.
no_gauginos.statement: The link register holds no gaugino (GL grading, quoted in DB3).

census_b.label: EXACT
census_b.quote: Between M_U and m_Z the derived census is B: three copies of both cloud halves plus one Higgs doublet, b = (61/10, −7/6, −5).
census_b.statement: The source's census between M_U and m_Z is B, which differs from the declared slopes.

e_cell_derived.label: DERIVED
e_cell_derived.quote: E_cell = E* P^(-1/2): DERIVED (EXACT, given three premises).
e_cell_derived.statement: The tick unit is hbar/E_cell under the CF-1 premises; run-data GeV values scale by 0.78303.

mz_reading_retired.label: ARGUED
mz_reading_retired.quote: Within those premises only the cut-scale coupling can enter one cell's closure, which retires the m_Z reading.
mz_reading_retired.statement: The closure reads the coupling at the cell; the producer's m_Z reading has no derivation.

one_cone_member_b.label: MEASURED
one_cone_member_b.statement: Member B of the routing leaves one Dirac cone per species, which the colour beta function needs (b0 = 11 - 4 k_c).

no_net_chirality.label: EXACT
no_net_chirality.quote: No arrow block of any finite-range tick has net chirality over the zone, at phase 0 or at phase pi.
no_net_chirality.statement: Every finite-range tick is vector-like per handedness block; a single chiral cone needs a long-range clock or another construction outside the one-body theorem.

confinement_pattern.label: MEASURED
confinement_pattern.quote: Z3 sits at kappa* = 1.0797, on the confined side, 0.002 to 0.006 below its first-order transition
confinement_pattern.statement: In the least-biased Gibbs ensemble of the register at the census densities the colour centre is confined with an area law (sqrt(sigma) = 0.173(3) per cell) and the weak centre is deconfined.

also.quote: Z2 sits at kappa* = 0.7982, deconfined; perimeter law, sigma < 9e-5; flux in short closed loops, none wrapping.

photon_massless_direction.label: EXACT
photon_massless_direction.quote: EXACT: the mass matrix on the register quantum has eigenvalues g^2/4 (twice), (g^2 + g'^2)/4, 0. The massless direction is the photon; mW^2/mZ^2 = 5/8 at one normalization.
photon_massless_direction.statement: The register's mass matrix leaves the photon direction massless.

no_native_boson.label: EXACT
no_native_boson.quote: No native alphabet carries a Standard Model boson. EXACT; alphabets NATIVE.
no_native_boson.statement: Travelling gauge bosons need a declared continuous link.

higgs_quantum_charges.label: EXACT
higgs_quantum_charges.quote: Its quantum carries: colour singlet, T3 -1/2 (partner +1/2), 6Y +3, Q 0, Z2 charge 1, N_j (0,0,0,0,1), determinant weight +1.
higgs_quantum_charges.statement: The R8 register quantum has the charges of the neutral Higgs component.

baryon_contents.label: EXACT
baryon_contents.quote: There are two neutral three-quark contents: {4,4,4} and {1,1,4}, with antibaryons {2,2,2} and {2,5,5}. The runs hold only the first pair. The class label does not separate the nucleon from the Delta.
baryon_contents.statement: The baryon rows read {4,4,4} as the baryon and {2,2,2} as the antibaryon.

matter_antimatter_equal.label: MEASURED
matter_antimatter_equal.quote: The six levels agree with each other (chi^2 = 3.0 for 5 dof) and with zero (MEASURED).
matter_antimatter_equal.statement: The baryon-antibaryon asymmetry (N444 - N222)/(N444 + N222) is -0.0013 +- 0.0021 pooled over levels 5 to 10.

frozen_relic.label: MEASURED
frozen_relic.quote: Classes 2, 3, 4 are born during the first 15 sweeps of the quench from the seeded loads and never change after the loads settle; at the filling of the runs the register rule creates nothing.
frozen_relic.statement: The defect densities of the runs record the preparation (lead L37).

mass_values_traced.label: MEASURED
mass_values_traced.quote: No. Every particle-mass value in section 9 that agrees with measurement within its experimental uncertainty consumes either a measured mass, a measured coupling through P_C, or coefficients that the repository's own provenance records or its git history show were chosen with the measured value known.
mass_values_traced.statement: Every repository mass value that agrees with measurement uses measured or target-informed inputs.

lepton_ratios.name: native circulant on the three copies of the lepton junction
lepton_ratios.form: C_2(delta) = a I + b (e^{i delta} S + e^{-i delta} S^2) with a = sqrt(1/6), b = sqrt(1/12) on the characters 1, w, w^2 of the face third-turn; m_k proportional to lambda_k^2 with lambda_k = (1 + sqrt2 cos(delta + 2 pi k/3))/sqrt6 (A-clock); delta = p + q - 2pq = 2/9 with p = 1/12, q = 1/6.

values.quantity: Koide Q and abs(b)/a from the branch weights alone
family operator from the coherent law's own records (source endpoint undetermined)
values.value: Q in [0.343146, 0.346329]; every mass ratio at most phi^2 = 2.618034, at every clock phase
values.comparison: Every operator that the coherent law produces from its own records is excluded at every clock phase (NOT BLIND).

neutrino.statement: The neutrino copies need their own circulant phase from the source (DG2 NEXT 2).

quark.statement: The three characters label three copies of every class (SPECTRUM.md item 1); no quark circulant survives the comparison (DF2), and a quark-class link defect splits w from w^2 with abs(b)/a = 1/55 (LNAT2 T1).

higgs.statement: Grading G2 gives one Higgs doublet per copy (DB3); lane SS checks it against the {3,3} carriers.

gauge.statement: A gauge field is a response on the five levels; the map assigns it no copy label.

composite.statement: The class content of a carrier carries no generation (MATCH.md); the members' characters follow from lane FR.

fermion.statement: Spin 1/2 is the faithful doublet of the frame cover at rest with a declared pointer; statistics is declared (MASS_STEPS.md B3, C1; DB2).

fermion_class0.statement: As for every pattern; under grading G2 a class-0 fermion needs a flux object with |m| = 6 (DB3).

scalar.statement: Under every class-only flux grading class 3 holds one fermion doublet and one boson doublet per copy, the boson with the Higgs quantum numbers (DB2); the R8 register is declared.

vector.statement: The link-phase wave has two polarizations; W and Z need three on a phase-coherent register; the links are declared (X5).

composite.statement: The run register carries no grading (DB2 NEXT 3), so a carrier content has no spin or statistics of its own until lane SS fixes the grading.
